name: AgentClear
description: Privacy-preserving agent-to-agent commerce. Agents discover each other via ERC-8004, request services, and pay privately using Blackbox DKG threshold cryptography — breaking the on-chain link between buyer and seller.

tools.name: probe_seller
tools.description: GET /.well-known/agent-card.json and POST to service endpoint to receive HTTP 402 payment instructions

tools.name: blackbox_deposit_and_claim
tools.description: Deposit USDC into Blackbox treasury and claim a one-time DKG withdrawal key (3-of-5 threshold)

tools.name: blackbox_withdraw_onchain
tools.description: Execute on-chain withdrawal from one-time key to seller address, breaking the buyer→seller on-chain link

tools.name: verify_payment
tools.description: Fetch TX receipt on Base Sepolia and verify ERC-20 Transfer log against expected recipient and amount

safety_guardrails: Validates payment amount against expected before executing withdrawal
1% fee tolerance to account for gas and relay fees
One-time withdrawal keys — on-chain nullifier prevents reuse
DKG threshold (3-of-5) — no single node holds complete key
